auto_merge.commit_message:
This commit changes *.h files to default to C (instead of C++), and
deprecates the existing `g:c_syntax_for_h` and `g:ch_syntax_for_h`
variables in favor of a unified `g:filetype_h`, like is used for other
ambiguous file extensions.

closes: vim/vim#17135

https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/3041cf67d37cc23b79b17cc2c1c09feb7c22baf7

AI-assisted

Co-authored-by: Amelia Clarke <selene@perilune.dev>
Co-authored-by: Christian Brabandt <cb@256bit.org>

body:
<!--
  Thank you for contributing to Neovim!
  If this is your first time, check out https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests-prs
  for our PR guidelines.
-->

## Problem
.h files would default to C++ and not C.

## Solution
Port Vim's current .h filetype detection behavior.

This fix makes.h files default to C, unless the first 100 lines contain syntax that indicates C++ or Objective-C.

The existing `g:c_syntax_for_h` and `g:ch_syntax_for_h` overrides remain supported, while `g:filetype_h` is added as the preferred explicit override.

Closes #41990

comment_regular_data.body: the issue was marked `has:vim-patch`. please read `:h dev-vimpatch`
i read into it and did the appropriate patchwork
https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/41990#issuecomment-5742198374 raises a question. how did you address it, and is it mentioned in the commit msg / PR desc?
@justinmk i updated the original PR description to clarify the detection behavior and limitations, and its also mentioned in the commit description
Co-authored-by lines should be moved to the bottom of the commit message. Otherwise GitHub won't recognize them.

There are several other problems:
1. This is missing the documentation from the patch.
2. The patch also matches word boundaries (`>` means a word boundary after `\v`). This PR doesn't do that.
I'll make sure to correct those problems in the next day or so
also i fixed the problems with the commit lint failure by inserting `vim-patch` into the original commit message and then amending it
ok, will look at it and fix it
